headline: Another boost for Tata Group shares: Tata Chemicals rises up to 14%, TCS jumps over 3%
summary: Tata Group shares rose after news that N Chandrasekaran's term as Tata Sons chairman would be extended by five years. Tata Chemicals climbed up to 14%, and TCS and Tata Motors also gained.
why: Tata Sons is the holding company of the Tata Group, one of India's largest conglomerates, spanning steel, autos, IT services and chemicals. Leadership continuity at the holding company matters to investors in its listed affiliates.
why_moved: Shares across the Tata Group rose after the news that the chairman's term at Tata Sons would be extended by five years, which reduces near-term leadership uncertainty.
